title: Payments DB queries timing out under peak load
symptoms: SQLTimeoutException query timed out on payments table during peak traffic; connection pool exhausted
rootCause: Missing composite index on payments(order_id, status) caused full table scans; long queries held connections until the pool was exhausted.
fix: Add the composite index, set a statement timeout, and raise pool size only after confirming query plans use the index.

title: Connection pool exhaustion after deploy
symptoms: Timeouts waiting for connection from pool; SQLTimeoutException spikes right after a release
rootCause: A new code path opened transactions without closing them on an exception branch, leaking connections.
fix: Use try-with-resources / @Transactional boundaries correctly, enable leak detection, and roll back the release.

title: NullPointerException in payment validation for wallet payments
symptoms: NullPointerException Card.getNetwork card is null when customers pay with a wallet
rootCause: Wallet payments have no card object, but the validator assumed every payment has a card.
fix: Branch validation on payment method type and add a null-safe check plus a unit test for wallet payments.

title: JWT signature failures after key rotation
symptoms: InvalidTokenException JWT signature verification failed for many users at once
rootCause: The signing key was rotated but some instances still cached the old public key (JWKS) for 24 hours.
fix: Reduce JWKS cache TTL, support both old and new keys during rotation, and restart stale instances.

title: Clock skew causing token validation errors
symptoms: Invalid token errors for tokens that were just issued; token not yet valid
rootCause: NTP drift on two nodes made freshly issued tokens appear to be from the future.
fix: Fix NTP sync on the nodes and allow a small clock-skew leeway (e.g. 30s) in token validation.

title: Inventory service returning 503 during deploys
symptoms: HttpServerErrorException 503 Service Unavailable from inventory-service for orders
rootCause: Inventory pods were terminated before readiness of new pods; no retry or circuit breaker in the orders client.
fix: Add readiness probes and rolling-update surge, plus retries with backoff and a circuit breaker in the client.

title: Downstream dependency slow, cascading timeouts
symptoms: Calls to inventory-service slow then failing with 5xx; thread pool saturated in orders
rootCause: No timeout configured on the HTTP client, so slow responses tied up all request threads.
fix: Set connect/read timeouts, add a bulkhead and circuit breaker, and return a degraded response.

title: SMTP relay refusing connections
symptoms: ConnectException connection refused smtp internal 587; notification jobs retrying
rootCause: The SMTP relay hit its max-connection limit because workers opened a new connection per email.
fix: Reuse pooled SMTP connections, cap worker concurrency, and queue emails with backoff.

title: Expired TLS certificate on internal mail relay
symptoms: Email sending failures; handshake errors to smtp relay
rootCause: The relay's TLS certificate expired and was not covered by certificate monitoring.
fix: Renew the certificate and add expiry alerts for all internal endpoints.

title: Out of memory building large exports
symptoms: OutOfMemoryError Java heap space while building export batch for large customers
rootCause: The export loaded the full result set into memory instead of streaming it.
fix: Stream rows with pagination or a cursor, write output incrementally, and cap batch size.

title: Memory leak from unbounded cache
symptoms: Heap usage climbs steadily until OutOfMemoryError; frequent full GC
rootCause: An in-process cache had no size limit or eviction policy.
fix: Bound the cache (max size + TTL) and add heap and GC alerts.

title: Consumer lag on ledger writer after schema change
symptoms: ConsumerLagException consumer group lag growing on several partitions
rootCause: A schema change added a slow synchronous lookup per message, cutting consumer throughput.
fix: Batch or cache the lookup, scale consumers up to the partition count, and monitor lag per partition.

title: Rebalance storm in consumer group
symptoms: Consumer lag spikes with repeated group rebalances
rootCause: Processing time exceeded max.poll.interval.ms, so consumers kept getting kicked out of the group.
fix: Reduce max.poll.records or speed up processing, and raise max.poll.interval.ms appropriately.

title: Disk full on log volume
symptoms: No space left on device; services failing to write logs
rootCause: Log rotation was misconfigured, so old logs were never deleted.
fix: Fix rotation and retention, clean up the volume, and alert at 80% disk usage.

title: Deadlocks on order status updates
symptoms: Deadlock detected errors when updating orders concurrently
rootCause: Two code paths updated orders and payments tables in opposite order.
fix: Update tables in a consistent order and keep transactions short.

title: Rate limit errors from payment provider
symptoms: 429 Too Many Requests from external payment provider
rootCause: A retry loop without backoff multiplied traffic during a provider slowdown.
fix: Use exponential backoff with jitter and respect Retry-After headers.

title: DNS resolution failures for internal services
rootCause: The DNS cache TTL was too long and pointed at decommissioned IPs after a migration.
fix: Lower DNS TTLs during migrations and configure the JVM DNS cache properly.

title: Thread pool exhaustion in notification workers
rootCause: Blocking calls to the mail relay ran on a small fixed thread pool with an unbounded queue.
fix: Make calls async or use a bounded pool sized to the relay's limits, with backpressure.
